#: The keyboard (run.py --cases keyboard --script scripts/keyboard.json --ini ini/keyboard_us.ini --expect expect/keyboard.json; the same with ini/keyboard_us_steamvr.ini). The right laser clicks Shift, H, I and Done on the US keyboard: a KeyboardCharInput for each character (its UTF-8 in cNewInput, with the user value given), then KeyboardDone; GetKeyboardText answers the text typed, and the keyboard's 1 m x 0.404 m quad was drawn.
